item.text: {"analysis":"The trial crashed after 14.03 allocated GPU-seconds and produced no validation score. The provided traceback only reports that train.py exited with status 1; it does not reveal the underlying exception, so the cause cannot be established. Finite-output/gradient diagnostics, checkpoint reload checks, and training completion are unverified. This run provides no evidence that gated attention improves or regresses HR@10 relative to the previously reported 0.5737 baseline.","code_summary":"One independently trained GRURec per category: tied item embeddings feed a two-layer GRU, followed by causal query/key/value attention over nonpadding recurrent states. Float32 attention safely handles fully masked rows. A learned elementwise gate, initialized with zero weights and bias 2, favors the recurrent state while incorporating projected history context. Dropout, projection, L2 normalization, and a single cosine-similarity scoring head with learned scale and item bias follow. Training retains independent positive/negative softplus losses with 8 uniform negatives, AdamW, AMP, clipping, and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor reconstructs the matching architecture and strictly loads one checkpoint per category; no ensemble is used."}
